UP TGT 2022 College Allotment Result - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pardesh Secondary Education Services Selection Board (UPSESSB) has released the College Allotment Result for selection to the posts of Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) the Advt. No. 01/2022. The vacancy came in the year 2022 and it took almost two years to conduct the written examination for the prescribed posts. The written examination was held on 03 – 04 June 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UP TGT College Allotment Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 09 June 2022
  • Application Start Date : 09 June 2022
  • Last Date : 10 July 2022
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 13 July 2022
  • Form Submit Last Date : 16 July 2022
  • Exam Date : 03 – 04 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 23 May 2026
  • Admit Card : 30 May 2026
  • Answer Key : 06 June 2026
  • Result : 30 June 2026
  • DV Letter : 02 July 2026
  • Final Result : 28 July 2026
  • College Allotment Result : 09 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC Candidates : Rs.750/-
  • EWS Candidates : Rs. 650
  • SC Candidates : Rs.450/-
  • SC Candidates : Rs.250/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs.375/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
